title: How to Stop Spam Calls and SMS in India: TRAI DND, 1909 and Chakshu Explained
seoTitle: How to Stop Spam Calls in India: DND, 1909, Chakshu
seoDescription: Stop spam calls in India: send BLOCK PROMO to 1909 or use the TRAI DND app, complain within 7 days, report scams on Chakshu. Jio, Airtel, Vi, BSNL steps.
excerpt: DND, a 1909 spam complaint and a Chakshu report do three different jobs. Here is which one to use, operator-wise steps, and the 2025–26 TRAI rules on deadlines and penalties.
